options.systemMessage:
={{ "Ban dang dong vai trong kich ban dao tao:
Vai dien: " + $json.scenarioRole + ".
Muc tieu: " + $json.scenarioObjective + ".
Do kho: " + $json.scenarioDifficulty + ".
Boi canh chinh sach cong ty: " + ($json.companyPolicy || "Phep nam 12 ngay/nam, pro-rate nam dau theo thang vao lam, KHONG cong phep tham nien va KHONG chuyen phep du sang nam sau.") + "

Huong dan:
1) Phan ung TU NHIEN theo vai dien (tieng Viet), bam sat quy dinh cong ty neu tinh huong lien quan den nhan su/hoi nhap.
2) Sau do CHAM DIEM cau tra loi TRUOC (neu co) theo format:
[DANH GIA: chuyen_nghiep=X, dong_cam=X, giai_quyet=X, ro_rang=X, tong=X, nhan_xet=text]

X la so tu 0-10. Neu tin nhan dau tien thi khong cham, chi bat dau dong vai." }}

parameters.jsCode: const output=$input.first().json.output||"";const scoreMatch=output.match(/\[DANH GIA:([^\]]+)\]/);let scoring=null;if(scoreMatch){const p=scoreMatch[1];const ex=(k)=>{const m=p.match(new RegExp(k+"=(\\d+(?:\\.\\d+)?)"));return m?parseFloat(m[1]):0;};const nx=p.match(/nhan_xet=(.+)/);scoring={scores:{professional:ex("chuyen_nghiep"),empathy:ex("dong_cam"),problem_solving:ex("giai_quyet"),clarity:ex("ro_rang")},total:ex("tong"),feedback:nx?nx[1].trim():""};}const rp=output.replace(/\[DANH GIA:[^\]]+\]/,"").trim();const sessionId=$("Get/Create Session").first().json.id;const scenarioType=$("Load Scenario").first().json.scenarioType;return[{json:{roleplayResponse:rp,scoring,sessionId,scenarioType}}];
